faq.a: Free estimates are offered. The business answers questions about cost on the phone.

faq.q: What is included with a panel upgrade?
faq.a: Our panel work includes a load check of the home, permit and inspection, and labeled breakers.

faq.q: How do I know if my wiring needs repair?
faq.a: Signs include flickering lights, warm outlets or switches, or a burning smell. Call to talk through what you see.

faq.q: Do you install indoor and outdoor lighting?
faq.a: Yes, we install indoor and outdoor lights, recessed lights and fixtures, with layout help and clean-up after the job.
Our work carries a 1-year workmanship warranty. The business answers detail questions on the phone.

service_pages.lead: Old or full panels replaced for Charlotte homes.
service_pages.what: A panel upgrade replaces an old or full panel so the home has the power it needs. Work includes permit and inspection, and breakers are labeled when done.
includes: A load check of the home

faq.q: What happens during a panel upgrade?
faq.a: Old or full panels are replaced so the home has the power it needs. We start with a load check of the home.

faq.q: Do I need a panel upgrade?
faq.a: Signs include breakers that trip often, a fuse box, or no room for new circuits.

service_pages.lead: Faulty wiring traced and repaired for Charlotte homes.
service_pages.what: Faulty wiring is traced and repaired safely, to code. We test circuits, fix damaged wiring and run a safety check when we finish.
includes: Repair or replacement of damaged wiring
A safety check when we finish

faq.a: We test circuits, then repair or replace damaged wiring. We do a safety check when we finish.

faq.q: How long does a wiring repair take?
faq.a: The business answers questions about timing on the phone after hearing about your home.

service_pages.lead: Indoor and outdoor lighting installed for Charlotte homes.
service_pages.what: Indoor and outdoor lights, recessed lights and fixtures put in right. We help with layout, install fixtures and dimmers, and clean up after the job.

faq.q: What kinds of lights do you install?
faq.a: We install indoor and outdoor lights, recessed lights and fixtures. We offer layout help and clean up after the job.

faq.q: Is new lighting right for my home?
faq.a: Signs include dark rooms, old fixtures, or outdoor areas with no light.

faq.q: Can you install dimmers with new fixtures?
faq.a: Yes, fixture and dimmer install is part of the work.
